purpose: Freeze the exact training-only model-selection, uncertainty, OOD and seam-continuity procedure for the Model-v1 10.5<sunDepressionDeg<=16.0 visibility-channel extension before any real late-twilight fit is executed.

outputsForV1Closure.note: The shortest V1 closure path extends the visibility-driving integrated channels with explicit uncertainty. Full late-twilight spectral-shape promotion is not implied by this procedure.
outputsForV1Closure.downstreamVisibilityInterval: earliestPossible/latestGuaranteed via existing starsvisibility visibility-event uncertainty solver

evidenceUse.admittedTrainingRows: preserve existing admitted labels unchanged when inside the declared <=16deg scope
evidenceUse.uncertaintyCandidateRows: use only the exact preregistered in-domain finite-underprecision/original-method evidence after block eligibility checks

exclusionOfIdw.reason: The late-twilight closure requires an explicit per-label likelihood and deterministic uncertainty-weighted objective. The existing IDW family has no frozen noisy-label likelihood and is therefore excluded pre-fit rather than retrofitted after outcomes are seen.

labelConstruction.positiveTransform: natural log of strictly positive channel mean

admittedLabelRule.measurementLogSigma: log1p(existing relativeStandardError) when finite and nonnegative

recompute: sample standard deviation with n-1 denominator

labelConstruction.modelDiscrepancySource: existing core-surrogate one-sigma log error budget; used as a predeclared weighting floor only, not as proof of late-twilight accuracy

crossValidation.fitUniverse: all eligible in-domain admitted labels plus eligible uncertainty-candidate labels; protected holdouts excluded
crossValidation.balancedFolds: five folds by sorted geometryId position mod 5
crossValidation.insufficientBoundaryFoldRule: if a depth boundary fold has fewer than 2 eligible validation rows it is retained as a diagnostic but not used in family score; this rule is decided before fit
crossValidation.perRecordPrimaryMetric: mean absolute standardized log residual across available positive channels
crossValidation.foldNllMetric: mean Student-t negative log likelihood per observed positive channel
crossValidation.baseline: fold-matched weighted constant-log-channel mean using identical row sigmas
crossValidation.readinessRule: selected candidate must improve mean scored-fold NLL versus baseline by at least 10 percent and all selected-candidate metrics must be finite

oodSupport.calibrationRows: eligible training geometry inputs only; no channel values needed
oodSupport.leaveOneOutDistance: nearest other eligible training geometry in frozen distance coordinates

seamContinuityAt10p5Deg.thresholdDerivation: 2 * existing core surrogate one-sigma log error budget 0.12
seamContinuityAt10p5Deg.failureOutcome: late-twilight support REFUSED at/near seam; no retuning

preliminaryPredictionUncertainty.channelSigmaLog: max(0.12, selected-model balanced-CV RMS log residual for channel, nearest eligible label totalTrainingSigmaLog)
preliminaryPredictionUncertainty.probabilityClaim: NONE; deterministic conservative interval for V1 propagation

independentBenchmarkRule.phase: after exact model, support and preliminary envelope are frozen
independentBenchmarkRule.benchmarkMismatchHandling: final envelope half-width may only widen to max(prefit half-width, observed matched benchmark absolute log residual); central model remains unchanged
independentBenchmarkRule.ifWidenedVisibilityIntervalIsOperational: design minimal targeted in-domain MYSTIC at highest first-visibility-impact geometry; do not launch broad campaign

artifactRequirementsAfterTrainingOnlyExe: exact eligible-row ledger with admitted vs uncertainty provenance
per-channel selected family/ridge and all CV metrics
central prediction plus preliminary lower/upper envelope
proof protected holdout values were not read

executionBoundary.nextAction: implement this exact procedure with synthetic/unit tests only; separately review the implementation and data loader before any real open-training fit
